summary.en: AI Robotics Engineer at AMTRAN TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering. Build robot control and learning systems across ROS 2, TM5S, NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, cuMotion, and Isaac GR00T, integrating perception, data workflows, policy inference, and real-robot validation.
summary.zh: 現任瑞軒科技 AI 機器人工程師，具備電機工程碩士背景。使用 ROS 2、TM5S、NVIDIA Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2、cuMotion 與 Isaac GR00T 建置機器人控制與學習系統，整合感知、資料流程、Policy Inference 與真機驗證。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Built ROS 2 control and simulation environments connecting TM5S, NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, and cuMotion for motion planning, collision handling, pick-and-place, and cable tasks.
Delivered Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, policy inference, and TM5S real-robot testing, integrating camera data, robot state / action, policy services, and robot commands.
Integrated RealSense, YOLO OBB, AprilTag, and OpenCV for 3D pose estimation, hand-eye calibration, TF conversion, and visual servoing in physical robot workflows.
Built Quest 2 teleoperation and imitation-learning recording workflows; automated task execution and data collection reached 3-4x manual operation in the same time window.

Independently delivered robotics software from requirements and architecture through Docker deployment, testing, on-site integration, and maintenance; cable-insertion success improved from 70% to 90% in a 10-trial test.
zh: 建置 ROS 2 控制與模擬環境，串接 TM5S、NVIDIA Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2 與 cuMotion，支援路徑規劃、碰撞處理、物件夾取與線材任務。
完成 Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練、Policy Inference 與 TM5S 真機測試，整合相機資料、Robot State／Action、Policy Service 與機械手臂指令。
整合 RealSense、YOLO OBB、AprilTag 與 OpenCV，完成 3D 姿態估計、手眼標定、TF 轉換與實機視覺伺服流程。
建立 Quest 2 遙操作與模仿學習資料錄製流程；自動化任務執行讓相同時間內的資料蒐集量達人工操作的 3～4 倍。
獨立負責機器人軟體從需求、架構到 Docker 部署、測試、現場整合與維護；線材插接成功率在 10 次測試中由 70% 提升至 90%。

experience.company_zh: 采威國際資訊股份有限公司（ISCOM）

en: Participated in backend API development, frontend integration, and web feature implementation using C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, MS SQL, and Git.
